title: Myotis
tagline: a small SSA-form compiler, written from scratch.
description: Hand-rolled compiler for a Lua-flavored language with full SSA form, dominator-based register allocation, and basic peephole optimization. Backend targets a custom register machine.

title: Lunara
tagline: ONNX → Triton: a lowering compiler for inference.
description: Reads ONNX graphs, performs operator fusion and shape inference, and emits Triton kernels for common patterns. Built to learn how production deep-learning compilers actually fit together.

title: PeanutOS
tagline: a teaching operating system for ARM.
description: Tiny OS targeting QEMU's virt machine — preemptive scheduler, simple page allocator, basic VFS, and a shell. Mostly an excuse to learn linker scripts properly.
